paragraphs: Chapter 570
Episode 148. Sword Emperor (2)
Of course, Ron wasn't crazy with grief over losing Dante, and he wasn't speaking as if Dante was alive without any basis.
"Lord Ron, are you saying... Dante is still alive?"
Ron nodded, and Jin barely calmed his heart that was welling up like a flood.
His heart was throbbing fiercely, as if he had run to the limit.

Since the start of the war, Jin had never given up on Dante. Not even when the monster that swallowed his friend said that his last will had disappeared, nor after the guy's sword and spear hesitated to cut him and Ron, and even after he was caught in this void.
Jin believed that Dante Hairan's existence hadn't completely disappeared from this world.
To be precise, he wanted to believe that, and he had to.
He didn't think he could endure this horrible fight if he thought Dante had completely vanished.
In fact, deep down, he couldn't shake off the thought that Dante was already dead.
"I can feel the child's energy. At the end of this void..."
The realization he gained as soon as he confronted the light of Genesis.
That was telling him the 'truth' that had been hidden behind the curtain of chaos until now.
This void was not just made of chaos, it was Gliek's inner self.
And because the effects of the long seal hadn't fully disappeared yet, and because the blackening hadn't been completed enough, Gliek hadn't yet realized what was left in his depths.
Dante Hairan.
The will of him, whom Gliek said had vanished, was still resisting in a corner of his abyss.
It was faint like a distant star, but it definitely existed. Even if it was in a state called 'unconsciousness'.
In other words, what brought Ron into the void with Jin was Dante's will remaining in Gliek's unconsciousness.
To ensure Jin didn't fall into this dreadful place alone, to ensure Jin didn't disappear here without any hope, the only person who could help him was his grandfather.
Dante was the same as Jin and Ron.
He too had never made a choice for himself in this horribly prolonged struggle.
"I am going to save that child from now on."
Ron's voice was trembling slightly.
Although trembling with emotion from the certainty that Dante was beyond, it wasn't just that.
Fear.

Fear that he might not be able to save Dante even after ascending to Genesis, fear of whether he could truly defeat Gliek on his own, fear that the hope he'd barely gained might vanish like a bubble....
Such emotions were embedded in Ron's voice.
It was an emotion that he hadn't felt when he was immersed in the heart of the demon and the demonization was progressing.
The dry and cold mental image unique to the being who just ascended to the newly formed Genesis couldn't erase his fundamental fear yet.
That was a sign of Ron's desperation.
Despair, death, and demonization all failed to shake him. The affectionate feeling towards his grandson was making him tremble.
"I'm scared."
Ron confessed his feelings to Jin.
"So, go with this old man. Can you do that?"
"Of course."
"In life."
Suddenly, Ron bowed to Jin.
Jin didn't react to this, but he didn't show any signs of surprise.
"I will remember it as an honor that will never come again."
Ron turned around as he continued.
Tszuzzuzzu...!
Rashid emitted a radiance. His blade was shining brighter than any other sword Jin had seen so far.
The light of Genesis that Ron achieved had entirely different attributes from that of Chiron.
If Chiron's Genesis was like the essence of a path, Ron's light was the path itself.
Therefore, unlike Chiron, his sword was not to break, cut, and kill something.
It was a sword to preserve, protect, and save.

Despite having been at the forefront of the empire for most of their history, the Hyrans, who walked alongside the history of the empire and the family, always aimed for the safety of the people, not plunder.
Even though they chose to embrace the white stone, they endured the disaster that power could bring to the world alone and never showed greed.
The long period of guardianship passed down from their ancestors was now lighting a fire in the darkness, tied to the sword symbolizing the head of the Hairan family.
In response to the light, the void vibrated even more fiercely. Gliek's resentment and anger seemed about to materialize and overwhelm the two at any moment.
In fact, that was Gliek's plan, but it was blocked by the counterforce of the radiance emanating from Rashid.
Then, as Ron swung his sword gently, the earthquake in the void stopped.
Instead, a chilling wind blew in from all sides, which was a scream filled with Gliek's pain.
The power of Genesis, which goes against fate, was finally causing him harm. It was a pain that Gliek had not felt in thousands of years.
Whooooa...!
A sound like sand blowing in the wind was heard.
That faint sound quickly amplified, causing a strong resonance throughout the void, and the next moment.
Jin could see the empty darkness of the void, which seemed like it would never be cut, scattering.
A crack was appearing in the void. Like a closed door shattering.
When Ron cut through the space in a straight line once more, a new path that hadn't been visible before opened up.
The passage that opened like the mouth of a dead beast was heading towards the abyss of Gliek.
The landscape beyond was entirely different from the void, which had been sturdy and stable until it began to vibrate.
A huge chaos, like a sea engulfed in a storm, was raging madly.
Despite having the warrior of Genesis right next to him, it was questionable whether he could really cross that hellish landscape.
However, the two did not hesitate and took large strides into the abyss, holding two swords shining like lanterns.
"If you're overwhelmed by the power, don't resist forcibly, hide behind me."
"I hope I won't have to, but I guess I can't cross it without relying on your border."
"That's what it's all about. That's why I also asked for your help to go together."
As soon as they set foot into the passage of the abyss, the sharp chaos pierced the two like a pickaxe.
Each one was too powerful for Jin to handle. Jin hid behind the shield called Ron whenever he struggled.
'It's not just a physical attack. Just like before, the chaotic energy that corrupts the mind is still continuing.'
But unlike before, Jin was not affected at all by the chaos trying to erode his mind.
Ron was using his sword to fight off the chaos and his energy to prevent their souls from being attacked.
Only Chiron and Ron could walk this long passageway of the abyss. Without the power of Genesis, it was impossible to prevent the erosion of the soul.
But the only one who could walk here with someone else was Ron.
The power of Genesis that Chiron had could not protect others from their minds being disturbed by the chaos.
Like a boat rocking in a storm, the two swayed and staggered from time to time, but they were clearly moving forward.
The closer the two approached, the more desperately Gliek tried to block their entry.
But they stood their ground time and again, looking as if they were about to fall, yet never showing a face crushed by crisis.
It was as if an unbreakable stone was rolling down a cliff.
Now, contrary to before, it was Gliek, not them, whose inner being was becoming flexible.
And he still didn't know why those hateful humans were risking so much to enter his abyss.
It would be better to go out and join other humans if they wanted to kill him, rather than destroy the abyss. He couldn't understand it at all.
He still didn't know that Dante was tied up at the bottom of his abyss.
"It seems we're almost there..."
Ron said in a tired voice.
Somehow, the two had reached the end of the passage.
Originally, his power should not have been exhausted even after crossing the waves of chaos, but he couldn't help it because he had shared some of Genesis's energy with Jin.
However, it was not to the extent that they couldn't complete the remaining mission.
Kaaaak...!
Gliek's scream, which had been ongoing, faded away.
As they reached the final stretch, the backlash of chaos had become much weaker compared to the beginning.
It meant that the end of this abyss was an area not under Gliek's control.
If he had been able to control this area, if the corruption had progressed just enough for him to do so.
Dante would have really vanished, as Gliek had said.
Finally.
The two faced a space of chaos that did not attack them.
A gentle black energy, which felt like a spirit rather than chaos, surrounded the two.
And there it was, the white stone...
As it was in the inner sanctum of the Sword Emperor's Castle before it was destroyed, they began to see Dante's figure sealed inside.
It was blurry due to the seal, but it was clearly recognizable.
In this quiet landscape of chaos that they had reached after overcoming and transcending much despair, the two couldn't even bring themselves to call out Dante's name.
Tears filled Ron's eyes as he swung his sword toward the seal.
The barrier was shattered with a single stroke, and finally,
Ron was able to embrace his grandson, freed from the chaos.
His throat was choked, and he couldn't speak for a while.
"Grandfather..."
Jin's throat was also choked, and he couldn't say anything, but Dante spoke weakly, making them even sadder.
"I couldn't... defeat him. I overcame everything... but foolishly... I was deceived at the end..."
"It's okay, Dante. It's okay, it's alright..."
Ron couldn't help but burst into tears like a child.
